editorial.blurb: SaiMai is a beloved Thai takeout spot in Lincoln Park where fresh, carefully prepared curries and soups arrive hot and perfectly packaged, whether you pick up in person or have them delivered.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the duck curry at spice level 1 if you love heat, and time your visit during less busy hours to snag one of their few dine-in tables—or grab extra to reheat the next day and skip the delivery fee markup.
